correctness.rationale: For \(Q\ge40\) and \(m\le\lfloor Q/20\rfloor\), direct comparison of the exact source minima selects explicit branches. In both parities the summand difference simplifies exactly to \(a_Q/[Q(m+\ell_Q(m))]\). Since \(0\le\ell_Q(m)\le1\), this block is \((a_Q/Q)(H_N+O(1))=(2/3)(\log Q)/Q+O(1/Q)\). The remaining tail is absolutely \(O(\sum_{m>N}m^{-2})=O(1/Q)\). The standalone checker confirms the branch inequalities and identities with exact rational arithmetic.
